_doc._: Example scope for /hunt. Root writes ~/.local/state/hunt/<slug>/scope.json in this shape and the user approves it once. Every value below is a neutral example. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored.
_doc.slug: [a-z0-9-]{1,40}; names the state directory, branches (hunt/<slug>, hunt-fix/<slug>/<N>, hunt-w/<slug>/<N>) and the label hunt:<slug>.
_doc.topic: The topic as the user stated it.
_doc.queue.tmp_env: Variables hunt-queue sets, for each job, to that job's own temporary directory (also exported as HUNT_JOB_TMP), removed when the job ends. Go: ["GOTMPDIR"].
_doc.repos: Map of repository key -> repository. The key is the REPO_KEY argument of hunt-forge and hunt-git.
_doc.repos.*.path: Absolute path of the main checkout. Never modified: the hunt works in worktrees under ~/Projects/.worktrees.
_doc.repos.*.forge: github | gitlab | forgejo | local (file-backed fake, tests only).
_doc.repos.*.api_url: Forge API base URL (GitLab v4, Forgejo v1). Ignored for github (gh is used).
_doc.repos.*.project: Full project path with every subgroup, unencoded; hunt-forge URL-encodes it.
_doc.repos.*.ca_file: Optional CA bundle for a forge behind a private PKI; null otherwise.
_doc.repos.*.token_env: NAME of the environment variable holding the token, never the token. One variable per forge: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (same as tracker.md), FORGEJO_TOKEN; null for github.
_doc.repos.*.owned: true: issues and fixes here. false: read-only; an issue is filed there and the hunt waits.
_doc.repos.*.base: Branch hunt/<slug> is cut from, and fetched again at the freeze.
_doc.repos.*.mr_target: Branch the MR/PR targets; its description carries every Closes #N.
_doc.repos.*.remote: Git remote hunt-push pushes hunt/<slug> to (default origin); <remote>/<base> is where the autosquash starts.
_doc.repos.*.globs.in: Paths a fix may touch. Root checks every integration's changed files against them.
_doc.repos.*.globs.out: Paths a fix must never touch, even if an in glob matches.
_doc.repos.*.lock: Exclusive project lock taken by hunt-queue --exclusive, under ~/.cache.
_doc.repos.*.image: Optional container image used by witnesses: env variable that names it, and the tag template; teardown removes *:hunt-<slug>-*.
_doc.repos.*.env: Environment applied to every build, test, vet and list command of this repository. GOTOOLCHAIN=local is mandatory for go.
_doc.repos.*.witness_tags: Build tag sets the witnesses use; one build and one static check per set (the empty set included).
_doc.repos.*.exclusive: Packages or tag sets whose witnesses start containers: their jobs run hunt-queue --exclusive.
_doc.repos.*.depends_on: Keys of owned repositories this one depends on: pushed first, then this one is re-pinned.
_doc.repos.*.repin: How hunt-push re-pins this repository on a dependency: {cmd: [argv...], env: {...}}, run in the integration worktree with this repository's env plus repin.env, then committed. Placeholders in cmd: {sha} (the dependency's pushed or merge SHA), {dep} (its key), {dep.<field>.<field>} (a field of its scope entry). null when depends_on is empty.
_doc.repos.*.go: Go adapter fields: module path (for re-pins) and race_denylist (packages or tests never run with -race).
_doc.imported_issues: Open issues on the topic that existed before the hunt: never refiled; they count toward the cap only when labelled hunt:<slug>.
_doc.matrix: Coverage matrix: one cell per behaviour x condition. A pass is complete when every cell has a verdict at the frozen SHA; hunt-push needs the latest verdict of every cell in the last pass to be clean.
_doc.matrix.*.id: The cell's identifier: the `cell` field of verdict and finding events.
_doc.matrix.*.witness: How the cell is played: package, test (name, or a template the hunter fills), tags, race, n (runs per play).
_doc.matrix.*.expect: Expected polarity on a correct implementation: green.
_doc.thresholds.cap: Maximum hunt issues open at once (outside fixed-local, needs-decision, off-topic, duplicates).
_doc.thresholds.resume_at: The hunter is woken again when the counter falls to this value.
_doc.thresholds.max_passes: Stop with a report after this many passes without convergence.
_doc.thresholds.max_hours: Stop with a report after this wall-clock time.
_doc.thresholds.stall_ms: A hunt in an active state whose beat is older than this, and not busy, is reported stalled. Must exceed the longest queue wait.
_doc.thresholds.disk_min_gib: Preflight refuses below this; during the hunt it raises pause: disk.
_doc.thresholds.witness_timeout_s: Per-run timeout of one witness process.
_doc.thresholds.integration_budget_s: Time an integration may spend verifying one issue; N_fix x duration above it makes the issue needs-decision.
_doc.thresholds.codex_defer_s: A Codex review still pending after this is abandoned, so the freeze can proceed.
_doc.budget: Computed by preflight from nproc and MemAvailable, fixers first; tokens is exported as HUNT_TOKENS to hunt-queue.
_doc.stopped_by_preflight: What preflight stopped (clusters, containers); teardown restarts it.
